'''N4-01''' was the designation of a [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in the service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It relayed to Imperial forces an urgent transmission from [[Darth Malgus]], asking them to come to [[Vaiken Spacedock]] for a [[Battle for Hammer Station|mission]] regarding the [[Advozse Hegemony]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
N4-01 can be found on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], and [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="TOR" />
